name: app-starts-windowed
description: The application window starts in a normal windowed state: visible, neither minimized nor fullscreen nor hidden.

steps.name: widgetVisible
steps.note: The window must actually appear. A start that leaves the app running with no visible window — tray-only, hidden, or failed show — never satisfies this.

assertions.note: The window is on screen. main() calls window.show() (src/app/main.cpp), so invisible here means the show was lost somewhere after it.
Not minimized to the taskbar. A start that opens straight into a minimized window reads as 'nothing happened' to whoever launched it.
Not fullscreen either. Windowed is the launch contract: a normal resizable window the user can move, resize and close.
